fix: Stop building a placeholder ToastEntry. Change `fn from_entry(entry: &ToastEntry, theme: &ControlTheme)` to `fn from_parts(title: &str, description: Option<&str>, theme: &ControlTheme)` (use `title` and `description` in place of `entry.title` and `entry.description`). In `Provider::build` call `Root::from_parts(&entry.title, entry.description.as_deref(), theme)`. In `From<Root>` delete the `let entry = ...` block and write `let visual = value.child.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| Root::from_parts(&value.title, value.description.as_deref(), &theme));`. This removes the dummy `ToastId(0)` and the title/description clones made even when `child` is set.
